title: An outline's depends accepts an existing item ID
lead: An outline's `depends:` value may name an item already in the roadmap by its ID as well as by its title, so filing a follow-up to existing work does not need the full title copied in.
findings_note: v1.11 relay 2026-10-15: filing s288 with `depends: s270` was refused with "depends on 's270', which is not in the outline or the index", although s270 is in the index; `depends` takes only titles, while `discovered_from` in the same outline takes an ID
boundary: **Not in this slice:** IDs for items in the same outline (they have none until import), and changing how titles resolve.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: `_resolve_outline_depends` (`src/slicer/ops.py:2202`) checks each value only against titles. docs/import.md (line 99) explains why titles are used: IDs do not exist until the outline is applied. That holds for new items in the outline, but not for items already in the index, which `discovered_from` already references by ID (`ops.py:2290`). The refusal message also says the ID is "not in the index", which is false and sent the 2026-10-15 orchestrator to `slicer set --depends-on` after the import.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/ops.py`: in `_resolve_outline_depends`, a value that is not a known title but equals an existing item's ID resolves to that item's title (titles still win). The unknown-reference message names both forms: "depends on 'x', which is neither a title in the outline or roadmap nor an existing item ID".
- `docs/import.md` (the `depends` row and the paragraph at line 99), `CHANGELOG.md`.
- `tests/test_import.py` or the existing outline-depends tests.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Resolve existing IDs and reword the message.
3. Update the docs and CHANGELOG. Mutation-check each new test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The full suite passes; `slicer check` passes.
- `slicer import` of a one-item outline with `depends: <existing id>` adds the edge.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Worktree `.worktrees/s289`, branch `feature/s289-outline-depends-id`. Commit only on the branch.
